subject: Emergency KV coherence guard: short-notice deploy (action required)
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Jane Davis <jane.davis@atlasretail.com>; Atlas Retail SRE <sre@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Emergency KV coherence guard: short-notice deploy (action required)

Hi Jane / Atlas SRE,

We discovered an intermittent KV-store coherence issue that can surface for a small subset of long-context inference requests (multi-shard, token-length > 12k) where stale KV entries cause token duplication or out-of-order tokens in the final response. This is low frequency but can lead to corrupted responses for specific workflows (not data loss).

We have a tested emergency guard (kv-coherence-guard-v1.0) that prevents the stale-KV path from being selected and forces a lightweight resync on affected shards. We need to roll this guard to Atlas's dedicated pool within the next three hours to eliminate the risk for your peak batch window.

Action items we request from Atlas SRE:
- Approve a 15-minute rolling restart window for inference connectors in region us-west-2 between 10:30–12:30 PT (we can target 11:00 PT if that works).
- Temporarily cap very-long requests (context > 10k tokens) to 1 rps per connector while we validate telemetry for 24 hours.
- If you prefer we can perform the connector restart on your behalf; please confirm a contact and Slack channel.

Attachments: kv-coherence-guard-v1.0.patch (patch bundle), sample-debug-trace-ATLAS-07-11.txt (example trace), deployment-instructions.md

Why this is safe: the guard is a minimal runtime switch that changes kernel selection for the KV read path and triggers a compact resync. We do not touch customer payloads, and no model weights are changed. Rollback is a single toggle (we can revert instantly if any regressions).

I'll be on standby in #atlas-ops and can join a call immediately. Please reply with your preferred time or allow us to proceed at 11:00 PT.

Thanks,
Sergio
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Jane Davis <jane.davis@atlasretail.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Atlas Retail SRE <sre@atlasretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Emergency KV coherence guard: short-notice deploy (action required)

Thanks for the heads up, Sergio. Appreciate the details. A couple quick questions before we greenlight the restart: 

1) How large is the potential blast radius? Will this impact inference for our real-time checkout flows if the restart overlaps peak?
2) Any chance of false positives where responses that looked "corrupted" are actually intended model outputs?
3) Can you confirm there is no customer data persisted or modified by the guard?

We can do 11:00 PT for a 15-minute rolling restart if you confirm the above. If Redwood can run the restart with a named on-call contact, that would simplify coordination.

—Jane
Head of Platform
Atlas Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jane Davis <jane.davis@atlasretail.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Emergency KV coherence guard: short-notice deploy (action required)

On Tue, Jul 11, 2028 at 09:12 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com> wrote:
> We discovered an intermittent KV-store coherence issue...

Jane — short answers:
- Blast radius: limited to connectors servicing very-long-context traffic (roughly 0.6% of your requests historically). Real-time checkout traffic typically uses shorter contexts and falls outside the impacted window. We will still minimize overlap with your peak; the rolling restart is non-disruptive for short-context requests.
- False positives: unlikely. The traces we surfaced show clear token repetition patterns that are inconsistent with model logits. We included a sample trace (sample-debug-trace-ATLAS-07-11.txt) in this thread.
- Data persistence: confirmed NO customer payload is written by this guard. It only toggles kernel selection and performs ephemeral KV resyncs in-memory.

Deployment notes (short):
- Patch hash: sha256: 3f7a9c1b...
- Toggle path: runtime.flags.kv_coherence_guard = true
- Rollback: set the flag to false and the connectors will revert within ~30s without restart.
- Post-deploy checks: we will run a targeted synthetic suite (10 long-context requests / connector) and report success/failure per connector.

Sergio — if you’re OK, please proceed at 11:00 PT and run the synthetic validation. Karthik will coordinate telemetry checks.

Marissa
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Jane Davis <jane.davis@atlasretail.com>, Atlas Retail SRE <sre@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Emergency KV coherence guard: short-notice deploy (action required)

Hi Jane — thank you and Atlas SRE team.

We proceeded with the rolling restart at 11:00 PT per your approval and toggled runtime.flags.kv_coherence_guard = true across all connectors in us-west-2. Summary:
- Connectors restarted in rolling batches (3 groups). Total downtime per connector: ~20–45s during graceful drain.
- Synthetic validation: 20/20 long-context requests returned expected sequences (no duplication).
- Telemetry: error rate for long-context paths dropped to baseline within 6 minutes post-deploy.

No customer data was read/written by the guard; we confirmed through logs and trace correlation. We attached the sample debug trace and the patch bundle for your records.

Next steps / follow-up: 
- We will publish a short postmortem and technical write-up to the Drive link here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=17aK_example_postmortem (working draft).
- I’m scheduling a 30-minute follow-up call tomorrow 10:00 PT to walk through the RCA and any remaining questions. Invite to follow.
- If you observe any anomalies (unexpected latencies, missing tokens), please reply to this thread or ping me directly; we will revert the guard immediately if needed.

Thanks again for the fast coordination.

Sergio Alvarez
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
Attachments: kv-coherence-guard-v1.0.patch; sample-debug-trace-ATLAS-07-11.txt; deployment-instructions.md
